releaseBoundary: This manually pinned primary-source security baseline is not a live updater. Refresh checkedAt, versions, securityFixCount and reference on the day of every public Direct release. This names the current M156 stable train; same-train version comparison is not a source review for another Chromium branch.
policy: The current widely deployed macOS Desktop Stable floor is Chromium 156.0.8078.48, published 2026-10-20; the official post lists 156.0.8078.47 for Linux and .47/.48 for Windows and Mac with 353 security fixes. The NeAntik runtime must be built from the pinned official stable source at or above this floor. A limited Early Stable 157 rollout is observed separately and is not treated as the widely deployed floor. Cross-branch runtime use still requires source-bound review.
